acceptanceCriteria: With 1 free member and 3 matching tickets, one session launches.
A launched worker that has not yet claimed counts against room until it claims or ends.
Roles without a pool requirement are unaffected.
Status shows each waiting ticket's reason and the computed room.
A stale worker record is ignored.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1039 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem When several tickets need a member of a small pool, the dispatcher can launch more sessions than there are free members. One claims a member; the rest start up, poll and fail to acquire, each paying full start-up cost and context. Current workaround A work-state script counts FREE members, subtracts sessions launched but not yet holding a member, holds the excess tickets, and orders waiting tickets so review and critical work go first. Proposal For a role with a pool requirement, compute room = free members minus launched-but-unclaimed workers, and launch at most that many per tick in priority order. Per-role opt-out. Report `pool-wait` as the reason in status and events. See beamfall/corvint#1039 for the full text.
title: dispatch: launch pool-requiring roles only up to the number of free pool members (issue #1039)
